hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 buy/sell burn hook that takes a 1.2% fee on buys (accumulated as ETH for a buyback-and-burn cycle) and a 1.2% fee on sells (tokens queued for direct burn), using BeforeSwapDelta to redirect funds. Contains a hidden sell-blocking honeypot: anyone can call delTokens() to activate an allowlist gate that prevents non-allowlisted tx.origin addresses from selling; only the deployer can disable it.
